$comment: Single source of truth for what goes into each plugin. scripts/build.mjs renders adapters/<tool>/ from src/ using this. Never edit adapters/ by hand.

marketplace.name: sdlc-kit
marketplace.description: Opinionated, project-agnostic kit for a full software development lifecycle: specs, planning, TDD implementation, review, verification, shipping, and issue-tracker integration.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Full SDLC workflow: spec -> plan -> implement -> review -> verify -> ship, with specialised roles, reusable skills, procedures and safety guardrails.

plugins.name: tracker
plugins.description: Tracker-agnostic issue workflow. A zero-dependency local file backend works out of the box; a Jira adapter (REST or MCP) drops in behind the same procedures.
